item.title: Open Source Management in AI Systems
item.description:
1. Overview

ISO/IEC 42001 §8.5 (AI system life cycle) and §8.6 (AI data management) cover requirements that must be managed during the AI system development stage. From an open source perspective, the key is license compliance for the open source components used in AI systems.

2. §8.5 AI System Life Cycle: Managing Open Source Frameworks and Models

2.1 Planning and Design Stage

When selecting the open source frameworks and models to use in the planning stage of an AI system, review their licenses in advance.
